summary.zh: 本次更新修复页面返回后滚动位置丢失，并清理更新日志的重复显示。
summary.en: Scroll positions are kept when returning from a detail page, and duplicated release notes are cleaned up.

items.zh: 概览页、Markdown 文件浏览、PR 详情页跳转后返回不再丢失滚动位置
items.en: Overview, markdown viewer and PR detail keep their scroll position after navigating back

items.zh: Releases 页不再显示混排的机器日志块，只保留可读的更新说明
items.en: The Releases tab no longer shows the raw machine changelog block, only readable notes

items.zh: 更新日志只包含当前版本的变化，不再混入之前几轮的内容
items.en: Release notes cover only the current round of changes, not earlier ones
